title: An investigation of Ti addition to optimize the tribological properties of TiCrNbTaW refractory high-entropy alloy
process_description: prepared by mechanical mixing in a planetary ball mill (150 rpm, ball-to-powder ratio 5:1, 8h) followed by spark plasma sintering with stepped temperature profile (1700°C for 10min without pressure, then 1500°C with 40MPa pressure for 10min)
